title: Zelensky Warns of North Korean Troop Deployment to Russia Amid Cyber Threats
description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has raised alarms about North Korea sending 30,000 to 50,000 troops to Russia to support its military efforts against Ukraine. He indicated that these troops could enhance North Korea's military experience and pose a greater threat to Asian countries. Zelensky also warned of an increase in cyberattacks from Russia, stating that hundreds or thousands of such attacks are expected. Reports suggest a potential 'limited invasion' of a NATO country by Russia, with cyber means as a possible attack vector. The situation is compounded by North Korean missiles being discovered in Ukraine, highlighting the growing military collaboration between North Korea and Russia. Zelensky is advocating for closer cooperation with South Korea, particularly in air defense systems, to counter these threats.

Key Points:
• Zelensky warns of 30,000 to 50,000 North Korean troops being sent to Russia.
• Increased cyberattacks from Russia are anticipated, with hundreds or thousands expected.
• Zelensky calls for enhanced military cooperation with South Korea for air defense.
